result:
Confirmado: `filesystem.ts:333-338` lee `.expandPath` y `.containsPathTraversal` de los bindings en runtime, pero `PermissionHostBindings` (`contracts.ts`) no los declara — es la misma forma que `impossible` en `execPromptHook.ts`. Aplico el mismo cast local `as PermissionHostBindings` sobre el literal, con el tipo importado como `import type` (no afecta runtime).

```json
{"module": "pattern:runtime-field-not-declared-on-return-interface",
 "edits": [
   {"file": "src/packages/permission/src/__tests__/sandboxWriteAllowlist.test.ts",
    "old_string": "import { describe, expect, mock, test } from 'bun:test'",
    "new_string": "import { describe, expect, mock, test } from 'bun:test'\nimport type { PermissionHostBindings } from '../contracts.js'",
    "replace_all": false},
   {"file": "src/packages/permission/src/__tests__/sandboxWriteAllowlist.test.ts",
    "old_string": "installPermissionHostBindings({ expandPath, containsPathTraversal })",
    "new_string": "installPermissionHostBindings({ expandPath, containsPathTraversal } as PermissionHostBindings)",
    "replace_all": false}
 ],
 "fixes": ["src/packages/permission/src/__tests__/sandboxWriteAllowlist.test.ts(29,33): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'expandPath' does not exist in type 'PermissionHostBindings'."],
 "skipped": []}
```
